sources.name: OPRA
sources.scope: Official OPRA runtime/database feeds used by the existing app
sources.cursor_strategy: source fingerprint and upstream revision metadata
sources.license_notes: The Android runtime checks the OPRA database feed directly on the app's approximately-daily refresh path and keeps its own last-known-good cache. Repository source-health timestamps therefore do not claim to represent every end-user OPRA refresh.

sources.name: AutoEq
sources.scope: Full structured ParametricEQ result corpus with upstream measurement-source and rig/context provenance
sources.cursor_strategy: repository commit plus per-file structured content hash
sources.license_notes: AutoEq software is MIT licensed, while measurements originate from multiple third-party sources. EQ Library republishes only structured equalizer coefficients generated by AutoEq, retains the upstream measurement source and rig/context as provenance, and does not redistribute raw third-party measurement data or treat the software license as blanket permission for that measurement data.

sources.name: MrChillStorm Headphone Target
sources.scope: Explicitly MIT-licensed author repository with structured headphone/IEM PEQ examples derived from the author's ISO 226:2023 target framework
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified manifest plus GitHub file blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: Repository LICENSE is MIT (copyright 2026 MrChillStorm). Only exact profiles enumerated in config/qualified_github_sources.json are publication-eligible. EQ Library presents these as creator/community tunings and does not endorse source claims about target superiority or scientific validity.

sources.name: Fairbuds by Juraj Fiala
sources.scope: Exact hand-authored Fairphone Fairbuds PEQ records from jurf/fairbuds; third-party-measurement-derived AutoEq outputs in the same repository are excluded
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified manifest plus GitHub file blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: The public jurf/fairbuds repository is identified by GitHub as MIT licensed. Publication is restricted to explicitly qualified files with repository history supporting author-origin. presets/main-ish.txt was refined by repository author Juraj Fiala by hand (commit 66cf13ae87429315e4c1d709d5c327c39e074e85). Presets generated from RTINGS, SoundGuys, DHRME or other third-party measurement inputs are not qualified by this source entry.

sources.name: oratory1990
sources.scope: Direct creator provenance for author-created EQ presets; structured filter values continue to arrive through separately automated qualified carriers such as OPRA
sources.cursor_strategy: creator source URL plus acoustic fingerprint of an automated qualified structured carrier
sources.license_notes: Direct Reddit-hosted creator currentness is paused while Reddit access is unavailable. OPRA-carried structured presets may retain direct creator provenance without duplicating the tuning, and AutoEq results derived from oratory1990 measurements remain AutoEq-created results rather than oratory-authored presets. No recurring manual input is required for this direct provenance lane; it resumes only through a compliant automated access path.

sources.name: Squiglink-compatible sources
sources.scope: Public Squiglink/CrinGraph-compatible measurement ecosystem and provenance used by automated structured carriers such as AutoEq
sources.cursor_strategy: public squigsites registry fingerprint plus separately preserved carrier provenance
sources.license_notes: EQ Library automatically monitors the public Squiglink site registry for ecosystem currentness. Squiglink phone-book and frequency-response records are measurement/provenance data rather than source-authored PEQ, so this source does not fabricate canonical filters from curves or browser-generated AutoEQ. Exact PEQ derived from Squig measurements continues to arrive through separately qualified automated carriers such as AutoEq with measurement-source provenance retained.

sources.name: Reddit audio communities
sources.scope: Public structured PEQ posts and original preset links
sources.cursor_strategy: post/comment IDs, timestamps, and deterministic scan fingerprints
sources.license_notes: Public community EQ coefficients are publication-eligible, but GitHub-hosted unauthenticated Reddit JSON requests returned HTTP 403 Blocked and Reddit requires an approved access path. Live scanning remains paused; no manual-input substitute, scraping, or circumvention is used. Existing archived and curated Reddit EQs remain preserved.

sources.name: Head-Fi
sources.scope: Recently active public full-size headphone and portable/IEM threads containing exact structured PEQ settings
sources.cursor_strategy: public forum RSS entry IDs plus public post IDs and acoustic fingerprints
sources.license_notes: A bounded public RSS/thread adapter checks recently active headphone/IEM threads without logging in or crawling arbitrary pagination. Exact coherent PEQ may publish Unverified with author and original post provenance; ambiguous identities, multi-profile posts, screenshots, curves, and malformed filters are quarantined. If the public feed/thread path becomes unavailable, the source degrades without deleting archive data.

sources.name: Audio Science Review
sources.scope: Recently active public Headphone & IEM Reviews & Discussions threads containing exact structured PEQ settings and traceable mirrors
sources.cursor_strategy: public forum RSS entry IDs plus public post IDs and acoustic fingerprints
sources.license_notes: A bounded public RSS/thread adapter checks the public Headphone & IEM forum without logging in or crawling arbitrary pagination. Exact coherent PEQ may publish Unverified with author and post provenance; mirrors deduplicate acoustically and ambiguous/malformed data is quarantined. Public-path failure preserves the last-known-good archive.

sources.name: The HEADPHONE Community / Headphones.com
sources.scope: Public creator/community EQ posts, measurements, and tuning discussions hosted at forum.headphones.com
sources.cursor_strategy: topic/post IDs, timestamps, and source content hashes
sources.license_notes: Publicly posted community EQ coefficients are publication-eligible. This is the single canonical registry identity for forum.headphones.com; preserve creator/username, topic/post URL, exact source filter structure, and label any EQ Library-derived conversion separately from the source-authored preset.

sources.name: HiFiGuides Forums
sources.scope: Public headphone and IEM discussion threads containing original structured PEQ settings
sources.cursor_strategy: topic/post IDs, timestamps, and source content hashes
sources.license_notes: Public numeric EQ coefficients are publication-eligible for this project when creator/username and original forum URL are preserved. EQ Library stores the structured coefficients and minimal tuning context, not unrelated forum prose, and does not access private or restricted content.

sources.name: Public GitHub repositories and Gists
sources.scope: Public structured headphone-specific and General EQ community presets discovered in GitHub repositories and Gists
sources.cursor_strategy: discovery queue plus immutable source blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: Public source-authored numeric EQ coefficients are handled through the same Unverified community policy as public forum EQs: preserve repository owner/creator and commit-specific source URL, parse exact values only, deduplicate mirrors by acoustic fingerprint, and quarantine ambiguous identity or malformed/unsupported data without blocking unrelated candidates.

sources.name: Topping Community
sources.scope: Public official and fan-made PEQ presets exposed through TOPPING Home community/configuration-center sharing
sources.cursor_strategy: authorized public preset/share identity plus acoustic fingerprint when an API/feed is available
sources.license_notes: TOPPING Home exposes public community PEQ, but its published terms prohibit unauthorized scraping, bulk downloading, interface reverse engineering, and authentication bypass. To honor the automation-first policy, this source is paused instead of depending on recurring manual capture. It can become scheduled only when TOPPING provides an authorized public API/feed or explicit permission; archived data is preserved.

sources.name: ParaEQ built-in General EQ presets
sources.scope: MIT-licensed source-authored device-independent tonal, utility, and genre presets from wabsto1/ParaEQ
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified source file blob SHA with upstream-change review gate
sources.license_notes: ParaEQ is MIT licensed (copyright 2026 wabsto1). Its qualified Models.swift source is now probed automatically each week. Published General presets remain pinned to the reviewed exact source structure; upstream changes are detected automatically and cannot silently reinterpret classification or mutate acoustic history.

sources.name: MilcioSSQ EQ built-in General presets
sources.scope: MIT-licensed source-authored five-band General EQ presets from MilcioSSQ/eq, excluding Flat and ambiguous labels that do not safely establish Sound/Genre/Utility intent
sources.cursor_strategy: pinned source file blob SHA plus source-record acoustic fingerprint; upstream changes are review-gated before replacing the qualified manifest
sources.license_notes: MilcioSSQ/eq is MIT licensed (copyright 2026 MilcioSSQ). EQ Library publishes exact source-authored gains at the source's declared 60/250/1000/4000/16000 Hz low-shelf/peaking/peaking/peaking/high-shelf bands with source-declared Q=1, keeps missing preamp null, and stores generated safety headroom separately.
